senses.en: to believe that something will probably happen
to regard something as necessary or reasonably required
to believe someone or something will arrive soon

ex.en: We expect rain, so take an umbrella with you.
ex.zh: 我们预计会下雨，所以带上雨伞吧。

ex.en: Employers increasingly expect graduates to demonstrate practical skills as well as a strong understanding of their subject.
ex.zh: 雇主越来越期望毕业生既展现实践技能，又具备扎实的专业知识。

col: expect to do something｜预计做某事
expect someone to do something｜期望某人做某事
tip: expect偏重认为会发生，hope偏重希望发生。

senses.en: an organisation whose members share an interest or activity
a place where people dance and socialise at night
a stick used to hit a golf ball or strike something

ex.en: I joined a chess club to meet new people.
ex.zh: 我加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部，想认识些新朋友。

ex.en: A school sports club can help students develop teamwork skills while encouraging regular physical activity.
ex.zh: 学校体育社团可以帮助学生培养团队合作能力，同时鼓励他们经常锻炼。

tip: join a club表示加入社团，不用join in a club。

senses.en: Soft white frozen flakes falling from clouds or covering the ground.
For snow to fall from the sky.

ex.en: Fresh snow covered the garden when we woke up.
ex.zh: 我们醒来时，新下的雪覆盖了花园。

ex.en: Heavy snow can disrupt public transport and prevent rural communities from accessing essential services.
ex.zh: 大雪可能扰乱公共交通，使农村社区无法获得基本服务。

tip: snow作名词通常不可数；下雪用it snows。

senses.en: To get something that someone sends, gives, or provides.
To welcome someone arriving at a place.

ex.en: Did you receive the photos I sent yesterday?
ex.zh: 你收到我昨天发的照片了吗？

ex.en: All residents should receive clear information about changes to public transport before new routes are introduced.
ex.zh: 在新线路开通之前，所有居民都应获得有关公共交通调整的明确信息。

col: receive an email｜收到电子邮件
receive a warm welcome｜受到热烈欢迎
tip: receive侧重收到；accept侧重愿意接受。

senses.en: a very high area of land with steep sides
a very large amount of something

ex.en: Snow covered the mountain even in the middle of summer.
ex.zh: 即使在盛夏，那座山仍被白雪覆盖。

ex.en: Mountain communities often face higher transport costs because steep terrain makes road construction more difficult.
ex.zh: 山区社区往往面临更高的运输成本，因为陡峭的地形增加了修路的难度。

col: a mountain of work｜堆积如山的工作
tip: 一座山用 mountain；山脉通常用 mountain range。

senses.en: causing harm or requiring careful attention
not joking, or thinking carefully about something

ex.en: The leaking pipe caused serious damage to our kitchen.
ex.zh: 漏水的管道给我们的厨房造成了严重损坏。

ex.en: Air pollution remains a serious threat to public health, especially in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 空气污染仍然严重威胁着公众健康，在人口稠密的城市尤其如此。

col: take something seriously｜认真对待某事
tip: serious about 后接名词或动名词，表示认真对待。

senses.en: in groups of two people or things

ex.en: I’d like you to line up in twos, please.
ex.zh: 请你们两个一组排好队。

senses.en: usual, expected, or typical in a particular situation
the usual state or level of something

ex.en: It is normal to feel nervous before an interview.
ex.zh: 面试前感到紧张是正常的。

ex.en: Flexible working hours are becoming a normal feature of employment in many sectors of the economy.
ex.zh: 弹性工作时间正成为许多经济领域中常见的用工安排。

col: normal working hours｜正常工作时间
tip: normal强调符合常态；ordinary强调普通、不特别。

senses.en: except if; if something does not happen or is untrue

ex.en: We will eat outside unless it starts to rain.
ex.zh: 除非开始下雨，否则我们就在外面吃饭。

ex.en: Public transport will remain unpopular unless local authorities improve its reliability and make fares more affordable.
ex.zh: 除非地方政府提高公共交通的可靠性并降低票价，否则它仍不会受欢迎。

col: unless otherwise stated｜除非另有说明
unless absolutely necessary｜除非绝对必要
unless circumstances change｜除非情况有变
tip: 表将来条件时，unless从句通常用一般现在时。

senses.en: Coming after the second and before the fourth.
One of three equal parts of something.

ex.en: Our flat is on the third floor, beside the lift.
ex.zh: 我们的公寓在三楼，电梯旁边。

ex.en: Approximately one third of the city's residents rely on public transport for their daily commute.
ex.zh: 该市约三分之一的居民依靠公共交通进行日常通勤。

tip: 表示分数：one third；two thirds。

senses.en: a soft hat, often with a stiff front part
a cover fitted over the end or opening of something
to set a maximum amount or level for something

ex.en: He pulled on his cap before leaving for practice.
ex.zh: 他戴上帽子后出门去训练。

ex.en: Governments could cap annual rent increases to protect households from sudden rises in housing costs.
ex.zh: 政府可以限制年度租金涨幅，以保护家庭免受住房成本骤增的影响。

col: a cap on fees｜费用上限
tip: cap作动词指设上限；a cap on后接受限项目。

senses.en: an official rule, or the system of such rules
the study or profession concerned with legal rules
a general scientific rule describing how something always behaves

ex.en: The law requires drivers to stop at red lights.
ex.zh: 法律要求驾驶员在红灯前停车。

ex.en: Governments should enforce environmental laws consistently to prevent businesses from gaining advantages through harmful practices.
ex.zh: 政府应始终如一地执行环境法律，防止企业通过有害行为获取优势。

col: the laws of physics｜物理定律
tip: 具体一条法律可数；法学用不可数的law。

senses.en: An outdoor area where children play, often with special equipment.

ex.en: The children raced to the playground after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，孩子们跑向了游乐场。

ex.en: Every neighbourhood should provide a safe playground where children can exercise and develop social skills.
ex.zh: 每个社区都应提供安全的儿童游乐场，让孩子锻炼身体并培养社交能力。

tip: 主要指儿童玩耍场所，不泛指专业体育场。

senses.en: Having a low temperature or feeling a lack of warmth.
A common illness causing sneezing, coughing, and a runny nose.
Showing little friendliness, affection, or sympathy.

ex.en: My hands were cold, so I put on gloves.
ex.zh: 我的手很冷，于是戴上了手套。

ex.en: Cold weather can increase household energy costs, placing additional pressure on families with limited incomes.
ex.zh: 寒冷天气会增加家庭能源开支，给收入有限的家庭带来额外压力。

tip: “觉得冷”用be cold；“感冒了”用have a cold。

senses.en: a long, thin fibre used for sewing
a connected sequence of ideas or online messages
to pass thread or another thin object through an opening

ex.en: I need some blue thread to mend this shirt.
ex.zh: 我需要一些蓝线来补这件衬衫。

ex.en: Clear transitions help readers follow the thread of an argument in a complex academic essay.
ex.zh: 清晰的过渡能帮助读者理解复杂学术文章中的论证思路。

tip: lose the thread指跟不上谈话或文章的思路。

senses.en: A strong metal used in construction and needed by the body.
A tool with a heated base for smoothing clothes.
To make clothes smooth using a heated iron.

ex.en: These old iron gates are too heavy to lift.
ex.zh: 这些旧铁门太重，抬不起来。

ex.en: A diet containing sufficient iron can help prevent anaemia, particularly among children and pregnant women.
ex.zh: 摄入足量铁的饮食有助于预防贫血，对儿童和孕妇尤其重要。

tip: 铁是不可数名词；熨斗可数，用an iron。

senses.en: the number 6
the number 6

ex.en: She arrived just after six (six o’clock ).
ex.zh: 她六点刚过就到了。

ex.en: He learnt to play the violin when he was six (six years old ).
ex.zh: 他六岁学拉小提琴。

senses.en: to hit a surface, especially a door, to make a sound
to hit something accidentally, often making it move or fall
a sound or blow caused by hitting something

ex.en: Please knock on the door before you come in.
ex.zh: 进来之前请先敲门。

ex.en: Strong winds can knock down trees, causing serious disruption to transport networks in urban areas.
ex.zh: 强风可能刮倒树木，严重扰乱城市地区的交通网络。

col: a loud knock｜响亮的敲击声
tip: 词首k不发音；敲门用knock on或at the door。

senses.en: creative expression through activities such as painting, sculpture, or drawing
objects or images created to express ideas or beauty
a skill developed through practice and careful understanding

ex.en: We spent the afternoon making art with coloured paper.
ex.zh: 我们花了一下午用彩纸创作艺术作品。

ex.en: Public funding for art can enrich community life and make cultural experiences accessible to a wider audience.
ex.zh: 公共艺术资助能丰富社区生活，让更多人有机会体验文化活动。

col: a work of art｜一件艺术作品
the art of conversation｜交谈的艺术
tip: art指艺术通常不可数；一件作品用a work of art。

senses.en: To move or act quickly, or make someone do so.
A need to act quickly because time is limited.

ex.en: We hurried home before the rain began to fall.
ex.zh: 我们赶在下雨前匆忙回家了。

ex.en: When teachers hurry through difficult material, students may struggle to develop a clear understanding of key concepts.
ex.zh: 教师匆忙讲解难点内容时，学生可能难以清楚理解核心概念。

col: hurry through something｜匆忙做完某事
tip: hurry up表示催促；in a hurry表示匆忙。

senses.en: Relating to people rather than animals or machines.
A person, as distinct from an animal or machine.

ex.en: This robot can recognise a familiar human voice.
ex.zh: 这个机器人能识别熟悉的人声。

ex.en: Human activity has significantly altered natural habitats, making wildlife conservation an urgent priority for governments.
ex.zh: 人类活动已显著改变自然栖息地，使野生动物保护成为各国政府迫切需要优先处理的事项。

tip: human是“人类的”；humane是“人道的”。

senses.en: The hard natural material forming much of Earth's surface.
Popular music with a strong beat, often featuring electric guitars.
Move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.

ex.en: We sat on a flat rock beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们坐在河边一块平坦的岩石上。

ex.en: Studying ancient rock layers helps scientists understand how the Earth's climate has changed over time.
ex.zh: 研究古老的岩层有助于科学家了解地球气候随时间发生的变化。

tip: rock 作岩石材料不可数；指一块石头时可数。

senses.en: one more, or a different one
one more person or thing, or a different one

ex.en: This cup is cracked, so please bring me another.
ex.zh: 这个杯子裂了，请再给我拿一个。

ex.en: Another reason to invest in public transport is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通的另一个理由是，它有望减少城市空气污染。

tip: 通常接单数名词；another two days表示再两天。

senses.en: a device that captures sound, images, or information
a wooden or plastic wind instrument with finger holes
a person who keeps an official record

ex.en: I placed the recorder beside her before the interview.
ex.zh: 采访前，我把录音机放在她身旁。

ex.en: Using a digital recorder allows researchers to review interviews carefully and identify recurring themes.
ex.zh: 使用数字录音机使研究人员能够仔细回顾访谈，识别反复出现的主题。

tip: play the recorder指吹竖笛，不是播放录音机。

senses.en: The number after seventeen and before nineteen.

ex.en: We baked eighteen muffins for the picnic this morning.
ex.zh: 我们今天早上为野餐烤了十八个松饼。

ex.en: In many countries, citizens gain the right to vote when they reach the age of eighteen.
ex.zh: 在许多国家，公民年满十八岁便获得投票权。

tip: eighteen是十八，eighty是八十；注意词尾发音。

senses.en: Say a poem or passage aloud, often from memory
Say a series of facts or details aloud

ex.en: My sister recited a short poem after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我妹妹背诵了一首短诗。

ex.en: Students who merely recite facts may struggle to apply their knowledge to unfamiliar problems.
ex.zh: 只会背诵事实的学生可能难以运用知识解决陌生的问题。

col: recite a list｜逐一念出清单
tip: recite强调出声背诵；memorise强调记住。

senses.en: Caring about others and willing to help them.
A group of things sharing similar features.

ex.en: Our kind neighbour brought us soup when we were ill.
ex.zh: 我们生病时，体贴的邻居给我们送来了汤。

ex.en: Schools should encourage students to be kind to others, helping create a more supportive learning environment.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生善待他人，帮助营造更有支持性的学习环境。

col: be kind to someone｜善待某人
tip: 形容词常接to；种类用a kind of加名词。

senses.en: having many clouds in the sky
not clear or transparent

ex.en: It was cloudy, so we left our sunglasses at home.
ex.zh: 当时天阴着，所以我们把太阳镜留在了家里。

ex.en: Solar panels can still generate electricity on cloudy days, although their output is usually lower.
ex.zh: 太阳能电池板在阴天仍能发电，不过发电量通常较低。

tip: 既可形容天空多云，也可形容液体浑浊。

senses.en: The family, education, and experience that shape someone's life
Information or events needed to understand a situation
The part of a scene behind the main subject

ex.en: Her background in nursing helped her care for Grandpa.
ex.zh: 她的护理经历帮助她照顾爷爷。

ex.en: Universities should provide equal opportunities for applicants from different social backgrounds, regardless of their family income.
ex.zh: 大学应为来自不同社会背景的申请者提供平等机会，不论其家庭收入如何。

col: a disadvantaged background｜弱势家庭背景
tip: 经历领域用background in；背景中用in the background。

senses.en: The length of time someone or something has existed.
A period of history with particular features.
To become older or make someone or something seem older.

ex.en: My grandmother learned to swim at the age of seventy.
ex.zh: 我奶奶七十岁时学会了游泳。

ex.en: As populations age, governments need to invest more in accessible housing and community healthcare services.
ex.zh: 随着人口老龄化，政府需要加大对无障碍住房和社区医疗服务的投入。

col: people of all ages｜各年龄段的人
tip: 表示在几岁时用at the age of，不用in。

senses.en: a word or words used to identify someone or something
to give a name or say what someone is called
the reputation someone or something has

ex.en: What name did you choose for your new kitten?
ex.zh: 你给新来的小猫取了什么名字？

ex.en: Companies often choose a memorable name to distinguish their products in an increasingly competitive market.
ex.zh: 企业往往选择容易记住的名称，以便在竞争日益激烈的市场中突出自己的产品。

col: make a name for yourself｜成名
tip: 英式name A after B表示以B的名字命名A。

senses.en: to put something with something else or increase an amount
to combine numbers to find their total
to say something more after an earlier statement

ex.en: Add a little milk if the soup is too thick.
ex.zh: 如果汤太稠，就加一点牛奶。

ex.en: Adding more green spaces to urban neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and provide habitats for wildlife.
ex.zh: 为城市社区增加绿地可以改善居民的身心健康，并为野生动物提供栖息地。

tip: add A to B表示把A加入B；add to还可表示增添。

senses.en: A period of twelve months
An annual period organised for education, business, or another purpose

ex.en: We moved into this flat almost a year ago.
ex.zh: 我们搬进这套公寓快一年了。

ex.en: A gap year can give students valuable work experience before they begin university studies.
ex.zh: 间隔年可以让学生在开始大学学习前获得宝贵的工作经验。

tip: last year等时间短语前不加介词；年龄用years old。

senses.en: A place where people are kept as punishment for crimes.
The state of being kept in a prison.

ex.en: The old prison has become a popular local museum.
ex.zh: 这座旧监狱已成为当地一处受欢迎的博物馆。

ex.en: Education programmes in prison can help individuals develop skills that support their successful return to society.
ex.zh: 监狱内的教育项目能帮助服刑人员培养技能，支持他们顺利回归社会。

tip: in prison指服刑；in the prison强调在监狱内。

senses.en: a group of words expressing a complete statement, question, or command
a punishment officially given by a court
to officially give someone a punishment in court

ex.en: Our teacher asked us to write one sentence about autumn.
ex.zh: 老师让我们写一个关于秋天的句子。

ex.en: Learning to vary sentence length can help students express complex ideas more clearly in academic essays.
ex.zh: 学会变化句子长度，可以帮助学生在学术文章中更清晰地表达复杂观点。

col: sentence someone to｜判处某人……刑罚
tip: 判某人某种刑罚用sentence sb to sth。

senses.en: Clothing covering the waist and legs, with separate leg sections.

ex.en: These trousers are too long, so I need them shortened.
ex.zh: 这条裤子太长了，我需要把它改短。

ex.en: Some employers require staff to wear formal trousers, while others allow more casual clothing in the workplace.
ex.zh: 一些雇主要求员工穿正式长裤，另一些则允许员工在工作场所穿得更休闲。

col: a pair of trousers｜一条长裤
tip: 用复数：trousers are；一条用a pair of trousers。

senses.en: Despite what has happened or what someone has said.
Used to add a reason or return to the main subject.

ex.en: It started raining, but we went for a walk anyway.
ex.zh: 虽然开始下雨了，但我们还是去散步了。

ex.en: Some residents oppose the new railway, but the government intends to proceed anyway because of its economic benefits.
ex.zh: 一些居民反对修建新铁路，但政府考虑到其经济效益，仍打算推进项目。

col: do it anyway｜无论如何还是去做
thanks anyway｜不管怎样还是谢谢你
tip: anyway是副词；any way指任何方式。

senses.en: brightness that enables sight, or a device producing it
not heavy, bright, or pale in colour
make something burn or provide brightness

ex.en: Warm light came through the curtains into our bedroom.
ex.zh: 温暖的光线透过窗帘照进了我们的卧室。

ex.en: Access to natural light in classrooms may improve students' concentration and reduce electricity consumption.
ex.zh: 让自然光进入教室可能有助于提高学生的专注力，并减少用电量。

tip: 光线通常不可数；一盏灯用a light；动词过去式常用lit。

senses.en: Say you are willing to give something or do something.
A proposal of help, an opportunity, or a place.
Say how much you are willing to pay.

ex.en: Our neighbour offered to carry the heavy bags upstairs.
ex.zh: 邻居主动提出帮我们把沉重的袋子搬上楼。

ex.en: Universities should offer practical training that helps students develop skills relevant to the workplace.
ex.zh: 大学应提供实践培训，帮助学生培养与职场相关的技能。

col: offer someone a job｜给某人提供工作
make an offer｜出价；提出提议
tip: 主动做某事用offer to do，不用offer doing。

senses.en: Likely to cause harm, injury, or serious problems.

ex.en: That broken step is dangerous, so please avoid it.
ex.zh: 那级破损的台阶很危险，请避开它。

ex.en: Poorly maintained roads can create dangerous conditions for cyclists, especially during heavy rain or after dark.
ex.zh: 维护不善的道路会给骑行者带来危险，尤其是在大雨中或天黑后。

tip: dangerous是形容词；修饰动作要用dangerously。

senses.en: having the colour of ripe tomatoes
the colour of ripe tomatoes

ex.en: She wore a red coat to the winter market.
ex.zh: 她穿着一件红色外套去了冬季集市。

ex.en: Designers often use red to draw attention to important warnings on machinery and in public spaces.
ex.zh: 设计师常用红色来突出机器上及公共场所中的重要警示。

tip: in the red表示负债或亏损，不是字面上的红色。

senses.en: a unit of distance equal to one thousand meters

ex.en: The nearest bakery is about a kilometer from here.
ex.zh: 最近的面包店离这里大约一公里。

ex.en: Providing reliable public transport within a kilometer of residential areas could reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 在居民区一公里范围内提供可靠的公共交通，可以减少人们对私家车的依赖。

tip: 美式拼写；英式为kilometre，符号km不加s。

senses.en: The world's largest continent, lying mainly east of Europe.

ex.en: My cousin spent three months travelling around Asia.
ex.zh: 我表亲花了三个月在亚洲各地旅行。

ex.en: Rapid urban growth in Asia has increased the need for affordable housing and reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 亚洲城市的快速发展增加了对可负担住房和可靠公共交通的需求。

tip: 洲名首字母大写，通常不加the；形容词为Asian。

senses.en: An opening with glass that lets light into a building
An area on a screen displaying a program or document
A limited period when something can be done

ex.en: Please open the window and let some fresh air in.
ex.zh: 请打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。

ex.en: Installing larger windows can reduce the need for artificial lighting in homes during daylight hours.
ex.zh: 安装更大的窗户可以减少住宅在白天对人工照明的需求。

col: a window of opportunity｜机会之窗
tip: 电脑窗口也叫window；机会之窗强调时机有限。

senses.en: A measure of how hot or cold something is.
A body temperature higher than normal because of illness.

ex.en: The temperature dropped sharply after the sun went down.
ex.zh: 太阳落山后，气温急剧下降。

ex.en: Rising ocean temperatures can damage coral reefs and threaten the survival of many marine species.
ex.zh: 海洋温度上升会破坏珊瑚礁，并威胁许多海洋物种的生存。

col: take someone's temperature｜测量某人的体温
tip: have a temperature通常指发烧，不只是有体温。

senses.en: Related to medicine or the treatment of illness.
An examination to check a person's health.

ex.en: The hotel called for medical help when a guest fainted.
ex.zh: 一位客人晕倒后，酒店呼叫了医疗救助。

ex.en: Governments should improve access to medical services in rural areas where hospitals are often far away.
ex.zh: 政府应改善农村地区的医疗服务可及性，因为那里的医院往往距离很远。

tip: medical作名词多用于英式英语，指体检，不指医生。

senses.en: The physical world, including plants, animals, and landscapes.
The basic qualities that make something what it is.
The qualities that shape how a person usually behaves.

ex.en: Camping helps us enjoy nature away from busy streets.
ex.zh: 露营让我们远离繁忙的街道，享受大自然。

ex.en: Understanding the nature of urban poverty is essential for developing policies that address its underlying causes.
ex.zh: 了解城市贫困的本质，对制定解决其根本原因的政策至关重要。

tip: 指大自然时通常不加the；某事的性质用the nature of。

ex.en: We still lack a pair of chopsticks.
ex.zh: 还少一双筷子。

ex.en: Before lunch he learned the foreigner how to use chopsticks.
ex.zh: 午饭前他教那个外国人怎样使筷子。

senses.en: Become greater in amount or size, or make something greater
A rise in the amount, size, or level of something

ex.en: The bakery increased its prices again this week.
ex.zh: 这家面包店本周又涨价了。

ex.en: An increase in public transport investment could reduce traffic congestion and improve air quality in cities.
ex.zh: 增加公共交通投资可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。

col: an increase in demand｜需求的增长
tip: 动词重音在后，名词在前；by接增量，to接终值。

senses.en: a formal meeting to discuss a particular subject

ex.en: Our hotel is hosting a conference for local teachers.
ex.zh: 我们酒店正在举办一场面向当地教师的研讨会。

ex.en: At the international conference, researchers discussed how cities could reduce air pollution without limiting economic growth.
ex.zh: 在国际会议上，研究人员讨论了城市如何在不限制经济增长的情况下减少空气污染。

tip: 指正式会议；参加会议用attend a conference。

senses.en: To express approval or admiration for someone or something.
Words expressing approval or admiration.

ex.en: Our coach praised us for helping the new players.
ex.zh: 教练表扬了我们帮助新队员的举动。

ex.en: Teachers who praise effort rather than natural ability may encourage students to persist when facing academic challenges.
ex.zh: 表扬努力而非天赋的教师，可能更能鼓励学生在学业遇到挑战时坚持下去。

col: praise someone for something｜因某事表扬某人
tip: praise sb for sth；名词通常不可数。

senses.en: in or to a foreign country

ex.en: My sister moved abroad and now lives near the sea.
ex.zh: 我姐姐移居国外，现在住在海边。

ex.en: Studying abroad can help students develop independence and gain a better understanding of other cultures.
ex.zh: 出国留学能帮助学生培养独立性，并更好地理解其他文化。

tip: abroad是副词：说go abroad，不说go to abroad。

senses.en: used to add another negative statement or alternative

ex.en: I could neither find my keys nor remember where I parked.
ex.zh: 我既找不到钥匙，也记不起把车停在哪里了。

ex.en: Expanding roads alone will neither solve traffic congestion nor reduce the environmental damage caused by private vehicles.
ex.zh: 仅仅拓宽道路既不能解决交通拥堵，也无法减少私家车造成的环境破坏。

tip: nor连接独立分句时常倒装：nor do I。

senses.en: A room or building equipped for exercise and sport.
Physical exercise taught or practised at school.

ex.en: I usually go to the gym before work.
ex.zh: 我通常在上班前去健身房。

ex.en: Affordable gym membership can encourage regular exercise, although safe outdoor spaces are equally important for public health.
ex.zh: 价格实惠的健身房会员服务能鼓励定期锻炼，不过安全的户外空间对公共健康同样重要。

col: go to the gym｜去健身房
tip: gym是gymnasium的简称；去健身房用go to the gym。

senses.en: An injury involving damage to skin or other body tissue.
To injure someone's body, especially by damaging the skin.
To hurt someone's feelings deeply.

ex.en: The nurse gently cleaned the wound on my knee.
ex.zh: 护士轻轻清洗了我膝盖上的伤口。

ex.en: Access to clean water and basic medical supplies is essential for treating wounds and preventing infection.
ex.zh: 获得清洁用水和基本医疗用品，对处理伤口和预防感染至关重要。

col: wound someone's pride｜伤害某人的自尊
tip: 伤口读/wuːnd/；wind的过去式wound读/waʊnd/。

senses.en: Belonging or relating to the person or people being addressed

ex.en: Please leave your shoes by the door before entering.
ex.zh: 进来前请把你的鞋放在门边。

ex.en: Choosing a university near your home can reduce living expenses and make higher education more affordable.
ex.zh: 选择离家近的大学可以减少生活开支，让高等教育更负担得起。

col: do your best｜尽你最大的努力
tip: your后接名词；yours独立使用；you're意为你是。

senses.en: Have the same opinion or accept someone else's view
Decide something together or promise to do something

ex.en: I agree with you that this soup needs salt.
ex.zh: 我同意你的看法，这汤需要加盐。

ex.en: Most researchers agree that regular physical activity can improve both mental health and academic performance.
ex.zh: 大多数研究人员认为，经常运动可以改善心理健康和学业表现。

col: agree with someone｜同意某人的观点
agree on a plan｜就计划达成一致
agree to do something｜答应做某事
agree to a proposal｜同意一项提议
tip: 同意某人用with；商定某事用on；答应做用to do。

senses.en: Something you ask to obtain information or an answer
An issue that needs discussion, consideration, or a decision
To ask someone for information or express doubt about something

ex.en: I raised my hand to ask the teacher a question.
ex.zh: 我举手向老师提了一个问题。

ex.en: Researchers increasingly question whether longer working hours actually improve productivity in modern office environments.
ex.zh: 研究人员越来越质疑，在现代办公环境中，延长工作时间是否真的能提高生产效率。

tip: 动词question可直接接人，表示询问或盘问。

senses.en: a person who flies an aircraft
done on a small scale to test whether something works
to fly an aircraft or test a new plan

ex.en: The pilot landed the plane smoothly despite strong winds.
ex.zh: 尽管风很大，飞行员还是平稳地让飞机着陆了。

ex.en: The council launched a pilot scheme to assess whether free bus travel would reduce traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 地方议会推出了一项试点计划，以评估免费乘坐公交车能否缓解交通拥堵。

col: pilot a programme｜试行一个项目
tip: pilot作定语常表示试点，如pilot project。

senses.en: With an audible voice rather than silently.

ex.en: Please read the recipe aloud while I mix.
ex.zh: 我搅拌的时候，请把食谱读出来。

ex.en: Reading stories aloud can help young children develop vocabulary and strengthen their understanding of spoken language.
ex.zh: 大声朗读故事可以帮助幼儿积累词汇，并增强他们对口语的理解。

tip: aloud强调发出声音，不一定像loudly那样响亮。

senses.en: the number

ex.en: She was sent to jail for eleven months.
ex.zh: 她被判入狱11个月。

ex.en: I never go to bed before eleven (11 o’clock ).
ex.zh: 我从不在11点钟以前上床睡觉。

senses.en: Not interesting or exciting.

ex.en: The film was so boring that I fell asleep.
ex.zh: 这部电影太无聊了，我都睡着了。

ex.en: Students may find repetitive exercises boring unless teachers explain their purpose and introduce variety.
ex.zh: 如果教师不解释练习的目的并增加变化，学生可能会觉得重复练习很乏味。

col: find something boring｜觉得某事无聊
tip: boring指令人无聊；bored指人感到无聊。

senses.en: Causing suffering without caring about others' feelings.
Causing great suffering or disappointment.

ex.en: It was cruel to laugh at her mistake.
ex.zh: 嘲笑她的错误很刻薄。

ex.en: Schools should address cruel behaviour early to ensure that every child feels safe and respected.
ex.zh: 学校应及早处理伤害他人的行为，确保每个孩子都感到安全并受到尊重。

col: be cruel to animals｜虐待动物
tip: 表示对某人或动物残忍，用be cruel to。

senses.en: worried or uneasy about what might happen
relating to the nerves in the body

ex.en: I felt nervous before my first swimming lesson yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天第一次上游泳课前，我感到很紧张。

ex.en: Students who feel nervous about examinations may benefit from regular practice and supportive feedback from teachers.
ex.zh: 对考试感到紧张的学生可以从定期练习和教师的鼓励性反馈中获益。

tip: nervous about后接名词或动名词，表示对某事紧张。

senses.en: used as an answer to say that you want something or want to do something
a large natural stream of water flowing towards another water body

ex.en: We watched ducks swimming across the river this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，我们看着鸭子游过河面。

ex.en: Protecting river ecosystems requires cooperation between farming communities, local industries, and environmental agencies.
ex.zh: 保护河流生态系统需要农业社区、当地企业和环境机构之间的合作。

tip: 河名通常带the，如the River Nile。

senses.en: a country occupying a continent between the Indian and Pacific Oceans

ex.en: My cousin moved to Australia to study marine biology.
ex.zh: 我的表亲搬到澳大利亚学习海洋生物学。

ex.en: Australia attracts international students through its universities, diverse cities, and opportunities to study in English.
ex.zh: 澳大利亚凭借其大学、多元化城市以及英语授课的学习机会吸引国际学生。

col: travel to Australia｜去澳大利亚旅行
study in Australia｜在澳大利亚留学
tip: Australia指澳大利亚；Austria才是奥地利。

senses.en: A place where ill or injured people receive medical treatment.

ex.en: She works as a nurse at the local hospital.
ex.zh: 她在当地医院当护士。

ex.en: Building a new hospital in the region would improve access to specialist care for rural communities.
ex.zh: 在该地区新建一家医院将有助于农村居民获得专科医疗服务。

col: be admitted to hospital｜入院治疗
tip: 住院：英式in hospital，美式in the hospital。

senses.en: Learning and practice that develop skills for a particular activity.
Physical exercise and practice to prepare for sport.

ex.en: My first day of training involved helping customers.
ex.zh: 培训第一天，我就参与了为顾客提供帮助的工作。

ex.en: Regular professional training helps employees adapt to technological changes and improves their long-term career prospects.
ex.zh: 定期职业培训有助于员工适应技术变化，并改善他们的长期职业前景。

tip: 通常不可数；一次培训可说a training session。

senses.zh: 克隆；无性系；无性繁殖；靠营养生殖而由母体分离繁殖的植物
senses.en: an animal or plant produced by scientists from one cell of another animal or plant, so that they are exactly the same
to make an exact copy of a plant or animal by taking a cell from it and developing it artificially
Information sent or left for someone to read or hear.
The main idea that a story, speech, or artwork communicates.
To send someone an electronic communication.

ex.en: Please leave a message if I miss your call.
ex.zh: 如果我没接到你的电话，请留言。

ex.en: Public health campaigns need a clear message that people from different backgrounds can easily understand.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传需要传达清晰的信息，让不同背景的人都能轻松理解。

col: get the message across｜把意思传达清楚
tip: message是可数名词；information通常不可数。

senses.en: the number equal to six times ten

ex.en: My grandfather turned sixty and celebrated with a picnic.
ex.zh: 我爷爷满六十岁时，办了一次野餐来庆祝。

ex.en: The survey found that sixty percent of respondents preferred reliable buses to additional parking spaces.
ex.zh: 调查发现，百分之六十的受访者更希望公交服务可靠，而不是增加停车位。

col: in your sixties｜在六十多岁时
tip: sixty重音在首音节；sixteen通常重读末音节。

senses.en: Physical activity for health, or a task for practising skills.
To do physical activity to stay healthy or become stronger.
To use a right, power, ability, or quality.

ex.en: I get some exercise by walking to the shops.
ex.zh: 我步行去商店，顺便锻炼一下。

ex.en: Regular exercise can improve mental health and reduce the risk of several common chronic diseases.
ex.zh: 经常运动能够改善心理健康，并降低几种常见慢性病的患病风险。

tip: 泛指运动时不可数；一项练习或一套动作中的动作可数。

senses.en: A small community of homes, usually in the countryside.
The people who live in a village, considered together.

ex.en: Our village has a bakery beside the old bridge.
ex.zh: 我们村的老桥旁有一家面包店。

ex.en: Reliable public transport can help village residents access employment, education, and healthcare in nearby towns.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通可以帮助村民前往附近城镇就业、求学和就医。

tip: the whole village可指全村居民，而非建筑。

senses.en: Protected from danger or unlikely to cause harm.
Unlikely to fail or lead to loss.
A strong locked container for money and valuable objects.

ex.en: Your bike is safe inside our locked garage.
ex.zh: 你的自行车放在我们锁好的车库里很安全。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all communities have access to safe drinking water and reliable sanitation.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有社区都能获得安全饮用水和可靠的卫生设施。

col: keep someone safe｜保护某人安全
tip: safe是形容词，safety是名词；注意词性区别。

senses.en: to tolerate something unpleasant or carry a heavy responsibility
a large, heavily built mammal with thick fur
to have or display a particular feature or mark

ex.en: I can't bear the noise of that old fan.
ex.zh: 我受不了那台旧风扇的噪声。

ex.en: Low-income households often bear the greatest burden when the cost of essential goods rises.
ex.zh: 生活必需品价格上涨时，低收入家庭往往承受最沉重的负担。

tip: 过去式bore；过去分词通常borne；出生用born。

senses.en: A knitted garment worn over the upper body for warmth.

ex.en: I pulled on a warm sweater before going outside.
ex.zh: 出门前，我套上了一件暖和的毛衣。

ex.en: Choosing a durable wool sweater rather than several cheap alternatives can reduce clothing waste over time.
ex.zh: 选择一件耐穿的羊毛衫，而不是多件廉价替代品，长远来看可以减少衣物浪费。

tip: 英式英语也常用jumper；sweatshirt指运动衫。

senses.en: an activity or contest played according to rules
wild animals hunted for food or sport, or their meat
willing to try something difficult or unfamiliar

ex.en: We played a board game after dinner yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天晚饭后我们玩了一个桌游。

ex.en: Cooperative games can help children develop communication skills and learn to solve problems together.
ex.zh: 合作型游戏能帮助儿童培养沟通能力，并学会共同解决问题。

tip: 猎物义不可数；be game for表示愿意尝试。

senses.en: The amount of money needed to buy something.
Something unpleasant experienced to achieve or obtain something else.
To decide how much money something will cost.

ex.en: The price of fresh strawberries has fallen this week.
ex.zh: 这周新鲜草莓的价格降了。

ex.en: Rising food prices place considerable pressure on families with limited incomes, particularly in urban areas.
ex.zh: 食品价格上涨给低收入家庭带来很大压力，在城市地区尤其如此。

tip: 价格高低用high或low；物品贵便宜用expensive或cheap。

senses.en: the day after Wednesday and before Friday

ex.en: We usually meet for lunch at home on Thursday.
ex.zh: 我们通常周四在家一起吃午饭。

ex.en: The university will host a public discussion on sustainable transport next Thursday evening.
ex.zh: 这所大学将于下周四晚举办一场关于可持续交通的公众讨论会。

tip: 星期名称首字母大写；具体某天前用on。

senses.en: A substance used with water to clean skin or objects.
A continuing television or radio drama about everyday relationships.
To rub or wash something with soap.

ex.en: Please wash your hands with soap before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前请用肥皂洗手。

ex.en: Providing clean water and soap in schools can help prevent infections and improve children's overall health.
ex.zh: 在学校提供清洁用水和肥皂有助于预防感染，改善儿童的整体健康状况。

col: a bar of soap｜一块肥皂
tip: 指清洁用品通常不可数；一块用a bar of soap。

senses.en: Something that you plan or mean to do.

ex.en: I had no intention of staying out so late.
ex.zh: 我原本没打算在外面待到这么晚。

ex.en: The government announced its intention to expand public transport in order to reduce traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 政府宣布计划扩大公共交通服务，以缓解交通拥堵。

col: with the intention of｜抱着…的目的
announce an intention to｜宣布做…的打算
tip: 用intention to do或intention of doing。

senses.en: Something done to achieve a result or address a problem.
A particular thing that someone does.
Exciting events in a story, film, or real situation.

ex.en: We need to take action before the leak worsens.
ex.zh: 我们得在漏水加重之前采取行动。

ex.en: Governments must take urgent action to protect coastal communities from the growing risks of climate change.
ex.zh: 政府必须紧急采取行动，保护沿海社区免受日益加剧的气候变化风险影响。

tip: take action中的action不可数；具体举动可用actions。

senses.en: The part of you that thinks, feels, and remembers.
To feel annoyed or uncomfortable about something.
To pay attention to something or take care of someone.

ex.en: Would you mind closing the window before you leave?
ex.zh: 你介意离开前把窗户关上吗？

ex.en: Regular physical activity can benefit both the body and the mind by reducing stress and improving concentration.
ex.zh: 规律的体育活动能减轻压力、提高专注力，从而有益于身心健康。

tip: 表示介意做某事用mind doing，不用mind to do。

senses.en: Things people or animals eat to live and grow.

ex.en: We packed enough food for a picnic by the lake.
ex.zh: 我们带了足够的食物，准备在湖边野餐。

ex.en: Reducing food waste at home can save money and lower the environmental impact of household consumption.
ex.zh: 减少家庭食物浪费既能省钱，也能降低家庭消费对环境的影响。

tip: 泛指食物时不可数；foods表示不同种类的食物。

senses.en: to demand something firmly despite disagreement
to state firmly that something is true

ex.en: My grandparents insist on paying for lunch every time.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母每次都坚持要付午餐钱。

ex.en: Many parents insist that schools provide regular physical education, even when academic subjects compete for classroom time.
ex.zh: 即使文化课挤占课时，许多家长仍坚决要求学校定期开设体育课。

col: insist on doing something｜坚持做某事
insist on payment｜坚持要求付款
tip: 用insist on doing，不用insist to do。

senses.en: An arrangement or idea for what to do in future.
To decide what to do and how to do it.
A drawing showing the layout of a building or area.

ex.en: Our plan is to leave early and avoid traffic.
ex.zh: 我们的计划是早点出发，避开拥堵。

ex.en: Cities need a clear plan for expanding public transport before introducing restrictions on private vehicles.
ex.zh: 城市在实施私家车限制措施之前，需要制定明确的公共交通扩展计划。

col: plan to do something｜计划做某事
tip: plan to do表示打算做；过去式planned双写n。

senses.en: someone who grows crops or raises animals on a farm

ex.en: The farmer feeds her chickens before the sun rises.
ex.zh: 这位农民在日出前给她的鸡喂食。

ex.en: Small farmers need reliable access to water and affordable technology to maintain production during dry periods.
ex.zh: 小农户需要可靠的水源和负担得起的技术，才能在干旱期间维持生产。

tip: farmer指人，farm指农场，farming指农业生产。

senses.en: To make something broken or damaged usable again.
To become healthy again after injury or illness.
To improve a damaged relationship or a difficult situation.

ex.en: Grandpa showed me how to mend a torn pocket.
ex.zh: 爷爷教我如何补好撕破的口袋。

ex.en: Teaching children to mend their clothes can reduce textile waste and encourage more responsible attitudes towards consumption.
ex.zh: 教孩子修补衣物可以减少纺织废料，并培养更负责任的消费态度。

tip: on the mend表示正在康复或情况正在好转。

senses.en: The upper front part of the body, enclosing heart and lungs.
A large strong box with a lid, used for storage.

ex.en: She held the sleeping kitten gently against her chest.
ex.zh: 她把熟睡的小猫轻轻抱在胸前。

ex.en: Workers exposed to polluted air may develop chest problems, highlighting the importance of effective workplace ventilation.
ex.zh: 接触污染空气的工人可能出现胸部疾病，这凸显了工作场所有效通风的重要性。

tip: chest指胸部或大箱子；chest of drawers才是抽屉柜。

senses.en: tell someone about possible danger or an unpleasant consequence

ex.en: Please warn me if the pan gets too hot.
ex.zh: 如果锅太烫，请提醒我。

ex.en: Scientists warn that continued habitat loss could put many more species at risk of extinction.
ex.zh: 科学家警告说，栖息地持续减少可能使更多物种面临灭绝风险。

col: warn someone about something｜提醒某人注意某事
warn against doing something｜告诫不要做某事
warn someone not to do something｜警告某人不要做某事
tip: warn后可接that从句；warn sb not to do表示告诫。

senses.en: one of the two body parts used for seeing
an ability to notice or judge particular qualities
to look at someone or something with particular interest

ex.en: She closed her eyes and listened to the rain.
ex.zh: 她闭上眼睛，听着雨声。

ex.en: Designers need an eye for detail to create public spaces that are both attractive and accessible.
ex.zh: 设计师需要善于观察细节，才能打造既美观又便于所有人使用的公共空间。

col: keep an eye on｜留意；照看
an eye for detail｜对细节的敏锐观察力
catch someone's eye｜引起某人的注意
tip: an eye for表示鉴赏力；keep an eye on表示照看。

senses.en: a person who gives a talk or addresses others
a person who speaks a particular language
a device that produces sound from electrical signals

ex.en: The speaker made everyone laugh with her opening story.
ex.zh: 演讲者开场讲的故事把大家都逗笑了。

ex.en: Inviting a guest speaker from the scientific community can help students understand how classroom knowledge applies to real problems.
ex.zh: 邀请科学界的嘉宾来演讲，可以帮助学生理解课堂知识如何应用于实际问题。

tip: a native speaker of English指英语母语者。

senses.en: A large musical instrument played by pressing black and white keys.

ex.en: My sister practises the piano after dinner every evening.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天晚饭后练钢琴。

ex.en: Learning to play the piano can help children develop concentration and express their emotions creatively.
ex.zh: 学习弹钢琴能帮助儿童培养专注力，并创造性地表达情感。

tip: 表示弹钢琴通常说play the piano。

senses.en: A substance used to treat or prevent illness.
The study and practice of treating and preventing illness.

ex.en: The pharmacist explained how often to take the medicine.
ex.zh: 药剂师解释了这种药应该多久服用一次。

ex.en: Advances in medicine have increased life expectancy, but access to effective treatment remains unequal across regions.
ex.zh: 医学进步延长了预期寿命，但各地区获得有效治疗的机会仍不平等。

tip: 服药用take medicine；表示医学时不可数。

senses.en: a person who serves in an army

ex.en: The soldier helped carry supplies across the flooded road.
ex.zh: 那名士兵帮忙把物资运过被洪水淹没的道路。

ex.en: Soldiers can support emergency services by delivering food and rescuing residents after major natural disasters.
ex.zh: 重大自然灾害发生后，军人可以通过运送食物和救助居民来支援应急部门。

col: serve as a soldier｜当兵服役
tip: 通常指陆军军人；水手和飞行员另有专称。

senses.en: a meal eaten outdoors, usually with food brought from home
to eat a meal outdoors for pleasure

ex.en: We had a picnic under a shady tree.
ex.zh: 我们在一棵树的荫凉下野餐。

ex.en: Public parks provide affordable spaces where families can enjoy picnics and spend quality time together.
ex.zh: 公共公园提供了花费不高的空间，让家庭享受野餐并共度美好时光。

tip: 动词过去式为picnicked，进行形式为picnicking。

senses.en: To learn to do something very well.
A person with exceptional skill in a particular activity.
Main or controlling all other related parts.

ex.en: After weeks of practice, Hana finally mastered the dance.
ex.zh: 经过数周练习，哈娜终于熟练掌握了这支舞。

ex.en: Students need opportunities to master practical skills rather than simply memorise information for examinations.
ex.zh: 学生需要掌握实用技能的机会，而不只是为考试背诵知识。

col: master a skill｜掌握一项技能
a master of｜某方面的大师
tip: 动词直接接宾语；硕士学位写作master's degree。

senses.en: a white substance used to flavour or preserve food
to add salt to food or preserve it with salt

ex.en: Please pass the salt before the soup gets cold.
ex.zh: 趁汤还没凉，请把盐递过来。

ex.en: Reducing salt intake is an effective way to lower the risk of high blood pressure.
ex.zh: 减少盐的摄入量是降低高血压风险的有效方法。

col: a pinch of salt｜一小撮盐
tip: 食盐通常不可数；“一小撮盐”用a pinch of salt。

senses.zh: 澳大利亚的；澳大利亚人的
senses.en: Relating to Australia or its people.
A person from Australia.

ex.en: We spotted several Australian animals at the wildlife park.
ex.zh: 我们在野生动物园看到了几种澳大利亚动物。

ex.en: Australian universities attract international students through a combination of research opportunities and diverse academic programmes.
ex.zh: 澳大利亚的大学通过提供研究机会和多样的学术课程来吸引国际学生。

col: Australian wildlife｜澳大利亚野生动物
tip: 国籍形容词首字母大写；指一个澳大利亚人用an Australian。
